summary: A Yes vote enacts an additional 0.75% city sales (transactions and use) tax beginning April 1, 2027, estimated to generate about $1,800,000 per year for general city services until repealed by voters.

tax.text: A Yes vote raises the sales tax to fund essential city services and increases city revenue.
tax.quote: If passed, the ballot measure would raise Fortuna’s sales tax to 1.5 cents — the same rate as Arcata and Eureka — to fund essential services, increasing city revenue by $1.8 million annually.

tax.text: A No vote does not enact the proposed sales tax increase.
